description: We are a team dedicated to using NASA Earth observation data to help farmers make informed crop rotation decisions. Our goal is to develop a decision-support tool that allows farmers to adapt to climate change, conserve water, and improve soil health, ultimately transforming agriculture for a sustainable future.
summary:
GreenRoots is a cross-platform web and Android decision-support application built for the Field Shift: Adapting Farms with NASA Data challenge. It transforms NASA POWER v2 Earth observations (GWETROOT root-zone soil wetness, PRECTOTCORR precipitation, T2M temperatures, and solar irradiance) alongside Open-Meteo agricultural forecasts into actionable 3-year, 6-season crop rotation plans.

Using GPS field-boundary mapping, 23 calibrated regional baselines, and a multi-objective optimization solver across 21 crops, GreenRoots evaluates Soil Health, Water Resilience, Economic Security, and Climate Risk—while flagging botanical-family repetitions that fuel pest and fungal cycles. Farmers can customize rotations, track live phenological growth stages on an operational calendar, and consult an integrated AI Senior Agronomist (Gemini 2.5 Flash with an offline-first fallback).

By replacing guesswork monocropping with satellite-grounded crop rotations, GreenRoots helps farmers conserve groundwater, reduce reliance on synthetic urea through biological nitrogen fixation, and build long-term climate resilience.
details:
What GreenRoots Does & How It Works

GreenRoots is a cross-platform web and Android precision agriculture platform built for the Field Shift: Adapting Farms with NASA Data challenge.

  1. GPS Field Profiling & Boundary Mapping: Farmers onboard in seconds using automatic GPS detection or an interactive Leaflet satellite map to pin their farm, draw custom parcel boundaries, and configure soil texture, organic matter, irrigation method, and sowing date across multiple fields.
  2. NASA Earth Data & Live Weather Pipeline: GreenRoots snaps coordinates to a 0.5° spatial grid and queries the NASA POWER API v2 (climatology/point, AG community) for GWETROOT (0–100 cm root-zone soil wetness), PRECTOTCORR (precipitation), T2M / T2M_MAX / T2M_MIN (temperatures), ALLSKY_SFC_SW_DWN (solar irradiance), RH2M, WS10M, and TS. It pairs this with live 5-day and 7-day agricultural weather forecasts from Open-Meteo (including reference evapotranspiration ET0 and foliar spray windows).
  3. Multi-Objective Crop Rotation Solver: Across 21 calibrated crops and 23 regional agro-ecological baselines, our solver evaluates 3-year, 6-season rotations across four metrics: Soil Health Index (SHI), Water Resilience Index (WRI), Economic Security Index (ESI), and Climate Risk Penalty (CRP). It presents three tailored strategies (Soil Regenerator, Drought Shield, and Balanced Market & Food Security) alongside an interactive Custom Rotation Builder that warns against repeating botanical families.
  4. Operational Calendar & AI Senior Agronomist: Green Roots tracks active phenological growth stages from sowing date and includes an AI Senior Agronomist powered by Google Gemini 2.5 Flash via a secure Vercel serverless endpoint (/api/chat), grounded in the farmer's live field profile and NASA telemetry, with an automatic offline-first deterministic fallback and voice input/output support.

Benefits & Intended Impact

  • Soil Restoration & Cost Reduction: Alternates legumes with cereals and oilseeds to fix atmospheric nitrogen biologically, reducing synthetic urea dependency and nitrate runoff.
  • Aquifer Conservation: Uses GWETROOT root-zone moisture and ET0 forecasts to prevent over-irrigation and recommend drought-resilient crop sequences.
  • Pest & Disease Disruption: Prevents consecutive same-family plantings that fuel Take-all, rootworm, and soil-borne nematodes.
  • Global Accessibility: Designed for smallholder farmers, agricultural extension officers, and agronomy advisors worldwide, working on any desktop browser, mobile browser, or Android devices (GreenRoots-v1.0.0.apk).

Tools, Languages & Software Used

  • Frontend: React 19, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS v4, Lucide React
  • Geospatial Mapping: Leaflet (Esri World Imagery / OpenStreetMap, with optional Google Satellite Hybrid & Terrain layers)
  • Mobile Runtime: Capacitor 8 (Android APK built with Gradle / Android Studio, including @capacitor-community/speech-recognition and @capacitor-community/text-to-speech)
  • AI & Backend: Vercel Serverless Functions (/api/chat), Google Gemini 2.5 Flash API, offline deterministic agronomic engine
  • Earth & Weather APIs: NASA POWER REST API v2 (grounded in MERRA-2 & SMAP references), Open-Meteo Forecast API, Nominatim reverse geocoding

Creativity & Key Factors Considered

  • Offline-First Rural Resilience: Farms often have weak connectivity. GreenRoots uses 0.5° grid quantization, localStorage caching, 23 pre-calibrated regional baselines, and a deterministic agronomic fallback engine so core planning and advisory features still work offline without AI hallucinations.
  • Security by Design: The Gemini API key is kept strictly server-side in Vercel (/api/chat) and never exposed in the browser bundle or Android APK.
  • Farmer-First Ergonomics & Voice Accessibility: Built with a mobile-first 4-tab layout, clear visual progress bars, and voice-to-text / text-to-speech support so farmers can interact hands-free in the field.
